rules.reply: Our retail store is located at Main Street, Dickwella, Southern Province, Sri Lanka.
Dickwella Fashion Corner is open Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Dickwella Fashion Corner accepts returns and exchanges within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unworn with original tags attached. Final sale and clearance items are non-returnable.
We provide islandwide delivery across Sri Lanka. Standard delivery within Western and Southern provinces takes 2-3 business days, and other provinces take 3-5 business days.
We accept Visa, MasterCard, Stripe, bank deposits, and Cash on Delivery (COD) for eligible apparel orders across Sri Lanka.
